projects.title: Cold Shelter
projects.description:
Cold Shelter is a first-person horror game that takes place in a snow-covered forest. Your car breaks down during a snowstorm, leaving you stranded in the middle of nowhere. Find shelter, explore your surroundings, find help and make your way out of there. Escaping the cold is only the beginning. This game features a linear story, environmental interactions, immersive graphics,
creepy atmosphere and AI behaviors. The game was developed in Unity.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented gameplay systems for interactions, objectives, dialogue, puzzles, and jumpscares, supported by a reusable trigger-based event system
-Implemented enemy AI with NavMesh-based navigation, roaming behaviour, chase encounters, and jumpscare events
- Implemented UI navigation and settings menus for graphics, audio, and general gameplay options
- Designed and built the entire game map
- Developed the game’s story
- Edited and integrated audio to support atmosphere and gameplay events
- Integrated third-party assets and adapted them to the game’s requirements

projects.title: Bowling Madness
projects.description: Bowling Madness is a 3D isometric endless platformer where you guide a bowling ball through a generated obstacle course. Move your mouse to steer and control the force applied to the ball—the farther the cursor, the greater the force. Navigate hazards, use launchers and power-ups, and knock down pins at the end of each section to gain extra time. See how far you can get before the timer runs out.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented a mouse-driven physics controller, timer, checkpoints, respawning, power-ups, and interactive obstacles with effects such as stunning, knockback, and launching
- Used object pooling to recycle course sections, enabling endless generation
- Designed all the course sections
- Created all the assets used in this prototype using Blender

projects.title: Battle Tanks
projects.description: A 2D multiplayer tank combat prototype featuring deathmatch, where players collect coins to replenish ammunition and keep firing. Includes a minimap, leaderboard, and lobbies with join-by-code functionality.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented multiplayer gameplay using Unity Netcode for GameObjects, with host and client support
- Implemented lobby creation and joining through session codes
- Developed tank combat, coin collection, and an ammunition system tied to collected coins
- Implemented a minimap and leaderboard

projects.title: Race to Pluto
projects.description: Race to Pluto is a 2D speedrunning platformer where you race through courses from Earth to Pluto, dodging enemies and obstacles while collecting fuel to reach your next destination. Each world has its own gravity, changing how you move and approach every course.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented enemy AI, respawn logic, a run timer, fuel collection requirements, planet-specific gravity and launchpads
- Designed the levels and created particle effects

projects.title: Isle of the Forsaken
projects.description: Isle of the Forsaken is a first-person, horror game that follows the story of a man stranded on a forsaken island trying to find his way back home.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented environmental interactions, jumpscares, objectives, dialogues, footsteps system and AI voiceovers
- Developed enemy AI with roaming, player detection, pursuit, and attack states
- Designed the level layout and established its atmosphere through lighting and environmental details.

projects.title: Turn Based Strategy Game
projects.description: A 3D turn-based strategy prototype where you command a squad in grid-based battles against enemy AI. Spend each unit’s action points to move, attack, or interact with the environment, then end your turn and face the enemy’s response. Use positioning and tactical abilities to defeat the opposing team.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented grid-based movement and pathfinding, unit management, action points, turn sequencing, and an action system for combat and world interactions
- Implemented enemy AI that scores available actions and selects the highest-rated option each turn
- Implemented ragdoll functionality when units die and breakable crates

projects.title: Whispers from the past
projects.description: Whispers from the past is a first-person, low-poly horror game follows the story of a broken father that did something horrible.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented environmental interactions, objectives, dialogue and object animations
- Designed the level

projects.title: Shut The Box
projects.description: A 3D prototype inspired by the board game Shut the Box, featuring numbered tiles from 1 to 12. Roll the dice and close any combination of tiles that adds up to the total, aiming to close them all. A mouse-driven dice throw lets you drag to set the direction and release to roll, with longer drags adding more spin and power.
projects.contributions: - Implemented mouse-driven dice throwing, dice result detection, tile-selection validation, and scoring logic.

projects.title: RPG Sandbox
projects.description: An RPG prototype featuring point-and-click movement, collectible melee and ranged weapons, and automatic attacks based on weapon range. Explore an area populated by roaming enemies that pursue you when spotted.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented point-and-click movement using Unity NavMesh
- Developed enemy AI with roaming, player detection, pursuit, and attack states
- Implemented weapon pickups and melee and ranged combat, with automatic attacks based on weapon range
- Created a health and damage system

projects.title: Cattywampus
projects.description: Cattywampus is a mobile word puzzle game available on iOS and Android, combining strategic word-building with daily challenges, power-ups and leaderboards. Players can race against the clock in Classic mode, play at their own pace in Carefree mode, or compete against other players in turn-based multiplayer Clash mode.
projects.contributions:
- Developed the core word-building gameplay, including tile dragging and placement, word validation, scoring, timers, and token currency
- Implemented Classic, Carefree, and asynchronous multiplayer Clash modes
- Built multiplayer flows using PlayFab, including turn-data exchange, invitations, random-opponent matching, friends lists, and an activity feed tracking active games and results
- Integrated PlayFab player accounts and a hybrid local/cloud save system supporting online and offline play
- Developed UI navigation and animated interactions using DOTween
- Implemented player statistics tracking, including highest scores and longest words across daily and all-time records
- Created an interactive tutorial to guide new players through the game’s mechanics
- Implemented profile customization, profanity filtering, daily streaks, and leaderboards
- Integrated the in-game shop, in-app purchases, and advertising
- Created a playable ad to showcase the game’s core mechanics
